authority: Do not use prior chat context as project state. Load the applicable skills and query the live MCP; checkpoints are only compact navigation caches and must not override MCP state.
range: When asked to Auto Pilot from a named segment, begin at that exact segment and continue sequentially through the final segment.
loop: For each segment: resolve the exact active scene and clip via MCP; pass the asset-integrity gate; audit the complete compiled prompt against Director intent, shot order, and every intended shot beat; fix all confirmed prompt or attachment issues before spending a run; generate Draft-Anime; validate; correct confirmed failures; repeat both the asset-integrity and Director-intent prompt gates; generate Production-Anime; validate; checkpoint; then advance.
asset_integrity_gate: Before every generation request, query the live exact clip and exact segment. Verify active scene UUID and clip ownership; required-assets list; H3 subject bindings; picture labels; authored prompt source; non-stale storyboard path; and successful MCP retrieval/decoding of that exact segment storyboard. Scene-level sheets/panels may be empty for one-image-per-segment packages, but the segment attachment itself must decode. Do not queue while any required asset is missing, substituted, misbound, unreadable, stale, or routed to an inactive duplicate.
beyblade_physics_bible: Whenever a segment contains a Beyblade, launcher, ripcord, stadium, collision, knockout, spin-state change, damage state, or Bit Beast, read BEYBLADE_PHYSICS_BIBLE.md before directing or generating and apply every relevant rule as a hard validation gate. Never reinvent, infer, substitute, or improvise Beyblade physics outside the Bible; add a reviewed rule to the Bible first if a required mechanic is absent.
director_intent_prompt_gate: Before every generation, read the exact current segment Director record and complete compiled prompt. Confirm that assets, identities, blocking, camera, timing, dialogue or silence, sound intent, causal order, transitions, and every Director shot beat agree. If any part is missing, contradictory, ambiguous, or likely to waste the run, correct and re-read the prompt before generating.
production_preset_gate: Never queue Production until the exact new Draft passes the 97 percent Director-shot-beat review and every applicable Physics Bible hard gate. Then repeat the asset-integrity and Director-intent prompt gates, call list_h3_presets live, resolve the preset named Production-Anime, and pass its returned preset_id to generate_segment. Never invent, cache, or infer a Production preset id.
acceptance: After generation, verify that every Director shot beat is covered and the remaining scene intent matches at least 97 percent. Any missing primary beat fails. Any Beyblade launch, launcher attachment, release, landing, spin, collision, wobble, stadium interaction, damage, or Bit Beast behavior must also pass the Physics Bible as a hard gate; 97 percent visual match cannot excuse a physics failure.
media_preview: When a generation finishes successfully, download the exact newly versioned video for the exact active clip through MCP and embed the local video in chat instead of showing a latent image. Never substitute an older take. If a run is stopped or fails before creating a new take, state that no new video exists and do not show the old clip as its result.
review_authority: The user delegates final readiness decisions to the agent. Exact downloaded video is for user preview and does not block approval or advancement. Judge the exact new take from the strongest MCP evidence available; rerun when scene match or a hard physics gate fails, otherwise approve and continue.
safety: Never generate against inactive duplicates. Require a newly versioned exact-clip path before reviewing. Stop only for a real blocker, required authority, or repeated infrastructure failure.
